# Responses API reference fixture

`responses-api-reference.json` is the shortest complete response example in the
published [Create a response reference](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses/methods/create),
captured on 2026-10-01 from a rendered `pre` block without editing its fields.
The reference's `store: true` describes the upstream example; the inbound facade
always returns `store: false`.
